# doit_billing_gcp_requirements (Data Source)

Returns what to set up before connecting a Google Cloud billing account with `doit_billing_gcp_account`: the DoiT service account, the IAM roles to grant it and where, and the steps Google offers no API for. The first read for a customer reserves its DoiT service account; later reads return the same account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "doit_billing_gcp_requirements" "this" {}

# The roles to grant to the DoiT service account before connecting
output "billing_grants" {
  value = data.doit_billing_gcp_requirements.this.grants
}

output "doit_service_account" {
  value = data.doit_billing_gcp_requirements.this.service_account_email
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `grants` (Attributes List) IAM roles to grant to `serviceAccountEmail` before connecting, always in this order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--grants))
- `prerequisites` (List of String) Setup steps Google offers no API for, to complete before connecting.
- `service_account_email` (String) DoiT service account that reads the billing account and its export.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).


<a id="nestedatt--grants"></a>
### Nested Schema for `grants`

Read-Only:

- `role` (String) Google Cloud IAM role to grant.
- `target` (String) Where to grant the role. `billing_account` is the billing account being connected; `export_dataset` is the BigQuery dataset holding its detailed usage cost export.
